events.description: Canadian singer-songwriter Ariel Posen (ex-The Bros. Landreth) is known for tasteful slide guitar and roots-soul songs. Sunday 19:00 show.
events.summary: A guitarist's guitarist: soulful slide guitar and warm songwriting from Winnipeg.
events.title: Ariel Posen – Bannatyne Tour

events.description: A folk-pop tribute to Simon & Garfunkel at Theater Rigiblick. The 18:00 Sunday start works for a relaxed evening. It repeats on Thursday 12 Nov at 20:00.
events.summary: Two voices and acoustic guitars: 'Mrs Robinson' to 'Bridge Over Troubled Water' in an intimate early show.
events.title: The Sound of Silence – Tribute to Simon & Garfunkel

events.description: Mühle Hunziken in Rubigen is a cult concert venue in a historic mill that has hosted greats for decades. Jake Bugg's Dylan-esque folk-rock ('Lightning Bolt') fits it perfectly. About 1h30 from Zurich.
events.summary: British folk-rock troubadour Jake Bugg in a legendary old mill venue near Bern — a proper gem.
events.title: Jake Bugg at Mühle Hunziken

events.description: The Gipsy Kings' 80s/90s rumba-flamenco hits make for a joyful, multigenerational evening. Volkshaus, show 20:00 per venue listing.
events.summary: 'Bamboléo' and 'Volare' — the Gipsy Kings' flamenco-rumba party is impossible not to dance to.
events.title: Gipsy Kings

events.description: Switzerland host North Macedonia in League B of the UEFA Nations League at the Swissporarena in Lucerne. Kick-off is 20:45 on a Tuesday, so it suits parents or older kids. Lucerne is an easy direct train from Zurich HB.
events.summary: A second home game for the Nati in Lucerne, three days after Slovenia, if you missed the first one.
events.title: Switzerland vs North Macedonia – Nations League

events.description: Around 200 exhibitors pour on ten ships moored on Lake Zurich, with masterclasses, a rotating tasting bar, guest wine regions, street food and an oyster bar. Hours are Mon–Sat 2–9pm and Sun noon–7pm. Tickets from CHF 36 (CHF 42 Fri/Sat), cheaper early-bird entry before 3pm, and masterclasses fill up fast.
events.summary: Date night on the lake: 4,700 wines on ten historic ships moored at Bürkliplatz, Switzerland's biggest tasting.
events.title: Expovina Wine Ships

events.description: The American Women's Club of Zurich hosts its Little Pumpkins Halloween Party for children aged 1–4, with a costume parade, crafts and games in English. It's a gentle way into the expat community; the club also runs a Thanksgiving potluck and Photos with Santa later in the season.
events.summary: An English-language costume party for toddlers from the American Women's Club: crafts, games and dressing up.
events.title: AWCZ Little Pumpkins Halloween Party (ages 1–4)

events.description: Lilu runs 14–24 Jan 2027, daily 18:00–22:00, with artists' light installations around the Old Town, Kapellbrücke area and lakeside. Follow the trail on foot in about 1–2 hours; free to walk. 45 minutes by train from Zurich.
events.summary: Light installations glow across Lucerne's old town and lakefront – a free winter-evening walk.
events.title: Lilu Light Festival Lucerne

events.description: The Swiss Käsefeste series ends on Rapperswil's Seequai with regional cheesemakers, tastings, cheese-making demos and cow milking for kids. Pair it with the castle and the rose gardens, and be back in Küsnacht for the lantern procession that evening.
events.summary: A free cheese festival on the Rapperswil lakefront, a 30-minute S-Bahn or boat ride up the Gold Coast.
events.title: Käsefest Rapperswil-Jona

events.description: GC host FC Luzern on the weekend of 19–20 December, the last round before the Super League's winter break after matchday 19. The exact day and kick-off are confirmed by the Swiss Football League.
events.priceText: Price TBA · see GC price list (U16 50% off)
events.summary: GC's final home game before the winter break, an easy pre-Christmas outing for the family.
events.title: Grasshoppers vs FC Luzern (last match before winter break)

events.description: One of the Gold Coast's loveliest Christmas markets, run by the Märtverein and local traders. Expect advent wreaths, crafts, toys and food stalls, plus tree-decorating on the village square during the day and Samichlaus walking through the market in the evening. The S-Bahn stops right in the village.
events.summary: About 150 festive stalls on the first Sunday of Advent in Meilen, with a Samichlaus procession through the market at dusk.
events.title: Meilemer Weihnachtsmärt

events.description: Editors' post-punk-tinged indie anthems are a live staple for the 2000s indie generation. X-TRA Haus der Musik, Limmatplatz.
events.summary: Birmingham's dark-hearted indie rockers Editors ('Papillon', 'Munich') in X-TRA's sweaty main hall.
events.title: Editors

events.description: Sababa 5 (IL/FR) mix Israeli and Middle Eastern melodies with funk, disco and psych grooves. Exil is a compact club at Hardstrasse.
events.summary: Tel Aviv's groove band: Middle Eastern psych-funk with retro 70s keys.
events.title: Sababa 5

events.description: Europaplatz next to the KKL turns into an ice rink from 11 November to 3 January, open daily 11:30–22:00. Skating is free (rental skates including kids' sizes available), with curling lanes, a beginners' area, Santa Claus appearances and skating disco nights. Fondue chalet and food stands on site.
events.summary: Free skating on 500 m² of ice by the lake in Lucerne, with Santa visits and skating discos.
events.title: Lucerne Ice Magic (Eiszauber)

events.description: A Zurich tradition since 1962: school classes build tiny illuminated boats that are launched from Stadthausquai at 18:00 and drift down the river. Watch from Weinplatz, where Zürich Tourism serves free hot punch and sweets. Short, magical and free.
events.summary: Hundreds of little lantern boats made by Zurich schoolkids float down the Limmat in the dark – free punch included.
events.title: Lichterschwimmen on the Limmat

events.description: Mar Malade (Alexander Hauer and Michèl M. Almeida) bring their fourth tour, 'Tourist': energetic, danceable and nostalgic indie pop from a multi-instrumental live band. Doors 19:00, show 19:30.
events.summary: A cheeky indie-pop duo with horoscope readings and pantomime between the songs.
events.title: Mar Malade + Klaus Egger Trio

events.description: Jucker Farm's famous autumn pumpkin exhibition at Juckerhof (Seegräben) and Bächlihof (Jona) has hand-sculpted pumpkin figures, pumpkin fries, pumpkin donuts and special Pumpkin Light Nights. Arriving by public transport gets you CHF 5 off your ticket. Combine it with the short hike around Pfäffikersee.
events.priceText: Free to visit exhibition; food extra
events.summary: Giant pumpkin sculptures, pumpkin fries and donuts at the farm above Lake Pfäffikon. The last weekend is 24–25 October.
events.title: Jucker Farm Pumpkin Exhibition

events.description: The former Burning Witches singer does a stripped-back seasonal show at the Kulturkarussell Rössli, Stäfa.
events.summary: An acoustic Christmas set from the Swiss rock singer, in a village inn.
events.title: Seraina Telli – X-Mas Acoustic Night

events.description: Jethro Tull's blend of folk, rock and flute ('Aqualung', 'Locomotive Breath') suits the elegant Kongresshaus hall by the lakefront. Show 19:00 per ticket listings. Seated, relaxed crowd.
events.summary: Ian Anderson's flute-wielding prog-folk legends Jethro Tull in the grand Kongresshaus on the lake.
events.title: Jethro Tull

events.description: The Veils (UK/NZ) play dramatic, literary indie rock. They appeared in 'Twin Peaks: The Return'. Club show at Salzhaus Winterthur.
events.summary: Finn Andrews' brooding, beautiful indie rock, loved by David Lynch fans from 'Twin Peaks'.
events.title: The Veils

events.description: David Eugene Edwards led 16 Horsepower and Wovenhand. Expect dark, spellbinding folk and banjo in the small Viadukt-arch club.
events.summary: The haunted gothic-Americana voice of 90s cult band 16 Horsepower, solo.
events.title: David Eugene Edwards

events.description: Replacing the old Wienachtsdorf, Bellevue Noël debuts on Sechseläutenplatz with a walk-through Advent wreath, market stalls and a fondue chalet. Full programme (including whether there is an ice rink and kids' activities) is due in October – check before you go. Closes 23 December.
events.summary: The new Christmas village in front of the Opera House, with a walk-through giant Advent wreath.
events.title: Bellevue Noël on Sechseläutenplatz

events.description: The slowUp loop starts in Schaffhausen's painted old town and crosses the border into the Hegau on car-free roads. Join anywhere, ride any distance, and add a stop at the Rhine Falls. It's under an hour by train from Zurich.
events.summary: A car-free family ride from medieval Schaffhausen into the German Hegau, close to the Rhine Falls.
events.title: slowUp Schaffhausen-Hegau

events.description: On the Sunday of Sechseläuten, Zurich's traditional children's parade winds through the city centre with guild-affiliated children in historical costume and dozens of bands. Children can register to march (see 'Teilnahme Kinderumzug' on sechselaeuten.ch). The next day (19 April) the Böögg burns at 18:00; Lucerne is the 2027 guest canton.
events.priceText: Free to watch; participation by registration
events.summary: Up to 3,000 children in historic costumes march through Zurich with 800 musicians – kids can even take part.
events.title: Sechseläuten Kinderumzug (Children's Parade)

events.description: Omar, the British soul singer who has worked with Stevie Wonder and Erykah Badu, plays Moods with QCBA (Quentin Collins & Brandon Allen's organ quartet). Acid jazz, neo-soul and jazz-funk; doors 18:00, show 19:00, standing.
events.summary: The UK soul king behind 90s acid-jazz classic 'There's Nothing Like This' with a Hammond-driven quartet.
events.title: Omar + QCBA

events.description: From November to February, UTO KULM on top of the Uetliberg runs its winter programme. It includes cheese fondue in the Maiensäss hut, a curling rink for families (up to eight adults and four kids), candle dipping on weekends, a small Christmas market, and a 3.1 km night sledge run when there's snow. Buy a torch and walk down the forest trail by torchlight.
events.summary: Zurich's own mountain goes wintry: fondue in a Maiensäss hut, curling, night sledging and torchlit walks down.
events.title: Winterzauber on the Uetliberg

events.description: Evanescence bring their arena tour to Zurich with Poppy and Nova Twins in support. Show starts 19:00 per the venue listing. Promoter Gadget flags it as 'Last Call', so remaining tickets are limited. Hallenstadion is a short S-Bahn/tram hop from Zurich HB via Oerlikon.
events.summary: Amy Lee's soaring 2000s goth-rock anthems like 'Bring Me to Life' fill Hallenstadion for a big-night-out.
events.title: Evanescence (with Poppy & Nova Twins)

events.description: The Kulturkarussell Rössli's Celtic night pairs Irish musicians Tom Byrne & Michael Carey with folk band Fell Line.
events.summary: Irish and British folk double bill to welcome spring on the Gold Coast.
events.title: Celtic Spring – Tom Byrne & Michael Carey / Fell Line

events.description: Openair St. Gallen runs 1–4 July 2027 in a nature reserve valley, with camping on site. The 2027 line-up is not announced yet (2026 had Twenty One Pilots and Nina Chuba). Tickets from about CHF 109.
events.summary: Switzerland's oldest big open-air, in the leafy Sittertobel gorge — four days of bands and camping.
events.title: Openair St. Gallen 2027

events.description: Finojet, formerly the singer of Calypso Cora, plays acoustic indie-folk from his 2025 debut solo album, with support from Tom River. Doors 19:00, show 19:30 at Papiersaal in Sihlcity.
events.summary: Aussie indie-folk with a big voice. He has opened for Xavier Rudd and The Head and the Heart.
events.title: Finojet + Tom River

events.description: Nena's shows mix her 80s classics ('99 Luftballons', 'Irgendwie, irgendwo, irgendwann') with later hits and have a famously family-friendly crowd. The Hall is just outside Zurich in Dübendorf. Lyrics in German, but the tunes need no translation.
events.summary: '99 Luftballons' live! The queen of 80s Neue Deutsche Welle in Dübendorf — a sing-along for all ages.
events.title: Nena

events.description: GC host FC Basel on the weekend of 28–29 November; the Swiss Football League announces the exact day and time. One of the atmospheric fixtures of the autumn.
events.priceText: Price TBA · see GC price list (U16 50% off)
events.summary: One of Swiss football's oldest rivalries: GC against FC Basel under the Letzigrund lights.
events.title: Grasshoppers vs FC Basel

events.description: The Punch Brothers' acoustic string-band wizardry is ideally suited to the AllBlues Neumünster church series. Doors 19:30, show 20:00, unreserved seats by zone, so come early. Ten minutes from Küsnacht.
events.summary: Chris Thile's virtuoso bluegrass-folk Punch Brothers in a church with glorious acoustics — a folk-lover's dream.
events.title: Punch Brothers in Kirche Neumünster

events.description: Brian Molko and Stefan Olsdal's arena show mixes new material with 90s and 2000s favourites. Placebo usually request a phone-free show. Hallenstadion, Oerlikon.
events.summary: 90s alt-rock icons Placebo ('Every You Every Me', 'Pure Morning') bring their brooding anthems to Hallenstadion.
events.title: Placebo

events.description: Paléo 2027 runs 19–25 July on the Plaine de l'Asse in Nyon. It welcomes all ages, with street performances and circus alongside music. The line-up isn't announced yet, and tickets usually sell out within hours of release.
events.priceText: Price TBA · Christmas offer Dec 2026 (under-12s free)
events.summary: Switzerland's biggest open-air festival: six days, seven stages, circus acts and a real village vibe.
events.title: Paléo Festival Nyon 2027

events.description: Rigiblick pairs literature with rock: Fahrenheit 451 is narrated in German, with a live band playing Radiohead in between. Only about 10 seats were left when checked.
events.summary: Bradbury's dystopia told on stage with Radiohead songs played live, for 90s kids.
events.title: Fahrenheit 451 – Ray Bradbury meets Radiohead

events.description: Zürich liest runs for six days with hundreds of events across the city, including a dedicated children's programme of readings, storytelling and workshops in libraries, bookshops and unusual venues. Mostly German; picture-book sessions work well for younger kids. Check the programme for English-language slots.
events.summary: Switzerland's biggest book festival brings storytelling sessions and reading workshops for children all over town.
events.title: Zürich liest – Kids' Programme

events.description: One of the National League's traditional big games, played at the Swiss Life Arena. Tuesday-evening game at 19:45. Family packages are available in sector K1 (from CHF 45).
events.summary: A classic rivalry: the Lions against record champions HC Davos, a preview of Spengler Cup hosts on Zurich ice.
events.title: ZSC Lions vs HC Davos

events.description: Black Sea Dahu have grown from Zurich's folk scene into an internationally touring indie-folk band. Salzhaus Winterthur show.
events.summary: Zurich's own atmospheric indie-folk band, with Janine Cathrein's deep, haunting voice.
events.title: Black Sea Dahu

events.description: Juno winners The Sheepdogs channel the Allman Brothers, CCR and The Guess Who with loose, joyous classic rock.
events.summary: Canada's retro rock'n'roll band: 70s harmonies, twin guitars and big hair.
events.title: The Sheepdogs

events.description: FC Zürich host St. Gallen on the weekend of 21–22 November; the Swiss Football League sets the exact date and time. Tickets from CHF 25 in sector B, and under-6s go free.
events.summary: November football at the Letzigrund against St. Gallen, whose fans always travel in numbers.
events.title: FC Zürich vs FC St. Gallen

events.description: BAP have been Germany's great dialect rock band since the late 70s, with a loyal Swiss following. Big, warm singalong crowd; lyrics in Kölsch, but the feel is universal.
events.summary: Cologne rock institution BAP ('Verdamp lang her') — Wolfgang Niedecken's heartland rock in Hallenstadion.
events.title: BAP

events.description: In Your Face Comedy runs a busy calendar of English-language stand-up in Zurich, including The NERDY COMEDY Show on 31 Oct 2026, 'Jokes, Jokes, Jokes' on Tuesdays and Comedy Brew on Thursdays. Tickets via Eventfrog; check the calendar for the exact venue and time.
events.summary: Halloween-night English stand-up for gamers and geeks – a fun expat date night in Zurich.
events.title: The NERDY COMEDY Show (English stand-up)
events.venue: In Your Face Comedy (Zurich venue per calendar)

events.description: The 98th Spengler Cup brings HC Davos, Frölunda, the U.S. Collegiate Selects, SCL Tigers, Adler Mannheim and Ilves Tampere to Davos. Games are at 15:10 and 20:15 daily, and the final is on 31 December. Afternoon games plus sledging or skiing make a classic family holiday day. Tickets on sale since 8 September.
events.summary: The world's oldest club hockey tournament between Christmas and New Year, in a snowy mountain village.
events.title: Spengler Cup Davos 2026

events.description: The Hendy brothers' Mary Wallopers play traditional Irish ballads and rebel songs with punk energy and plenty of banter.
events.summary: Rowdy, witty Irish folk from Dundalk: pub-session energy on a Saturday night.
events.title: The Mary Wallopers

events.description: Switzerland's best-known pumpkin show at Juckerhof farm in Seegräben takes 'Bon voyage' as its 2026 theme, with huge sculptures, photo points, carving stations and pumpkin fries. In October, Pumpkin Light Nights run on Fridays and Saturdays. Kids under 12 free; free shuttle bus from Uster station as parking is limited. A sister show runs at Bächlihof in Jona until 1 Nov.
events.priceText: Adults CHF 11 weekdays / CHF 13 weekends; kids under 12 free
events.summary: Giant pumpkin sculptures of camel caravans and hot-air balloons, pumpkin carving and glowing Pumpkin Light Nights.
events.title: Pumpkin Exhibition 'Gute Reise' at Juckerhof

events.description: Schüpfheim's cheese market opens around 10:00 on 26 Sept 2026, with the procession of more than 300 cattle from about 11:30. A genuinely local Lucerne-hinterland affair with alp cheese to buy. Reachable by train from Lucerne.
events.summary: 300+ cattle and a cheese market in the UNESCO Entlebuch biosphere – authentic and uncrowded.
events.title: Entlebucher Alpabfahrt, Schüpfheim

events.description: Tonhalle-Orchester Zürich family concert conducted by David Bruchez-Lalli, with actress-soprano Anna Gitschthaler and the Cantaleum school choir. Two performances, 11:15 and 14:15. Narration in German, but the music carries the story.
events.summary: Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition becomes a museum mystery story with orchestra, singer and kids' choir.
events.title: Family Concert: Pictures at an Exhibition — A Museum Thriller

events.description: The Schweizer Kindermuseum in Baden runs its new special exhibition 'Das tapfere Schreiberlein' (to April 2028), alongside the rocking-horse show 'Hü, Rössli hü!' (until 2 May 2027) and a big permanent toy collection. Open Tue–Sat 14:00–17:00, Sun 10:00–17:00. A great rainy-afternoon trip, 20 minutes from Zurich HB.
events.summary: A playful hands-on exhibition about writing, letters and scribbles at Baden's lovable Kindermuseum.
events.title: 'Das tapfere Schreiberlein' at the Swiss Children's Museum

events.description: This Is the Kit make warm, intricate folk songs loved by fans of Laura Marling and The National. Show 20:30. Small venue, so tickets go.
events.summary: Kate Stables' gentle, banjo-laced indie-folk (This Is the Kit) in the snug Bogen F arch club.
events.title: This Is the Kit at Bogen F

events.description: Just a nylon-string guitar and that voice: González is one of indie-folk's most loved performers. Volkshaus's 1920s hall is atmospheric and central in Kreis 4.
events.summary: Swedish folk guitarist José González ('Heartbeats') casts a hushed spell in the historic Volkshaus.
events.title: José González

events.description: The reclusive Manchester indie outfit behind 'Go Tell Fire to the Mountain' play one of Zurich's best small rooms, tucked under the Viadukt arches in Kreis 5, with DJ Bottom. Doors early, show 20:30. Tiny capacity, so buy ahead.
events.summary: Cult Manchester indie band WU LYF in the intimate railway-arch club Bogen F — a rare, sweaty gem of a gig.
events.title: WU LYF at Bogen F

events.description: Expat Expo fills the Kongresshaus with exhibitors from international schools, finance and lifestyle, plus seminars on learning German, Swiss taxes and US tax for Americans abroad. The Happy Hedgehog playgroup and a bouncy castle keep kids busy. Entry is free, but register online.
events.summary: A free day for English-speaking Switzerland: schools, tax and relocation experts, a bouncy castle and supervised play.
events.title: Expat Expo Zurich 2026

events.description: Circus Knie brings its 2027 programme to Zurich from 6 May to 6 June 2027, its longest stop of the tour. Clowns, acrobats and Knie's famous horse acts; the big top traditionally stands in central Zurich. Tickets via Ticketcorner – book early for weekend matinees.
events.priceText: Price TBA · via Ticketcorner (2026 tour from CHF 20.90)
events.summary: A month of Switzerland's national circus in the city – the classic Swiss family outing.
events.title: Circus Knie in Zurich

events.description: Part of the Opernhaus 'Musikgeschichten' series: a short musical story with live musicians and singers, made for children from 4. Runs 5–20 December. In German, but music-led and very visual.
events.summary: A cosy musical fairy tale for ages 4+ at the Opera House – a perfect first opera experience.
events.title: Der Zauberschatz im Rhein – Musical Story for Little Ones

events.description: The Locarno Film Festival 2027 is listed for 4–14 Aug 2027 (the festival had been studying a July move from 2027, so recheck). Evening Piazza Grande screenings on a giant screen are the highlight, many with English subtitles; daytime family films too. Pair with a Ticino summer holiday.
events.summary: 8,000 people under the stars on the Piazza Grande – Europe's most beautiful open-air cinema.
events.title: Locarno Film Festival 2027

events.description: A band concert at the Kulturkarussell Rössli, right by Stäfa station. The small hall has bar seating.
events.summary: Swiss blues-rock veterans in Stäfa's cosy old inn: an easy Gold Coast date night.
events.title: Willy & The Sheiks

events.description: Arlo Parks tours her third album 'Ambiguous Desire', with support from BAIRD. Seated balcony tickets are already gone; standing tickets remain. Doors 19:00.
events.summary: Mercury Prize-winning poet-songwriter in Kaufleuten's Klubsaal.
events.title: Arlo Parks

events.description: Swiss band Dada Ante Portas play a stripped-down anniversary set at the Kulturkarussell Rössli.
events.summary: Swiss 90s radio favourites go unplugged in Stäfa's village culture house.
events.title: Dada Ante Portas – TENplugged

events.description: The Hammershøi exhibition at Kunsthaus Zürich closes on 25 Oct 2026. His quiet grey-lit Copenhagen rooms are rarely shown in such depth. Also on: Wu Tsang's installation until 31 Dec 2026.
events.summary: Last chance for the hushed, luminous Danish interiors of Hammershøi – a calm date-afternoon show.
events.title: Vilhelm Hammershøi: The Eye That Listens (last weeks)

events.description: The duo present 'Los Ojos Del Condor', inspired by the Andes. All shows (20 Dec matinee and evening, 21 Dec) are sold out; Kaufleuten raffles returns, and resale tickets are invalid.
events.summary: Swiss-Ecuadorian brothers' cinematic desert-guitar instrumentals, produced by Dan Auerbach. Sold out.
events.title: Hermanos Gutiérrez

events.description: Thomas Anders performs the Modern Talking hits plus solo material in the comfortable, fully seated Theater 11 in Oerlikon. Guilty-pleasure 80s nostalgia at its finest.
events.summary: 'You're My Heart, You're My Soul' — Modern Talking's Thomas Anders brings peak 80s Euro-pop to Theater 11.
events.title: Thomas Anders (Modern Talking)

events.description: Zurich's big street food festival takes over the Hardturm site with more than 150 vendors, bars and entertainment over several weeks in late May and June. The 2026 edition ran 27 May to late June, so 2027 is expected in the same window; dates not yet announced. Family-friendly on weekend afternoons.
events.summary: 150+ food vendors for weeks on the Hardturm wasteland, from dumplings and tacos to oysters and raclette.
events.title: Street Food Festival Zürich 2027

events.description: Grammy-nominated Raul Midón blends soul, jazz and folk with dazzling percussive guitar. He plays AllBlues' Neumünster church series in Zurich's Seefeld.
events.summary: The virtuosic blind singer-guitarist ('trumpet' mouth solos!) in a beautiful church acoustic.
events.title: Raul Midón

events.description: The Ultimate Eagles recreate the Eagles' harmonies and hits note for note. Volkshaus, show 20:00. An easy date night with no stadium stress.
events.summary: 'Hotel California' and 'Take It Easy' — a faithful Eagles tribute for a relaxed classic-rock night.
events.title: Ultimate Eagles

events.description: Molly Hamilton's Widowspeak play hazy, country-tinged dream-pop, with support from John Andrews & The Yawns.
events.summary: Dreamy, twangy Brooklyn indie: soft Americana for a Monday wind-down.
events.title: Widowspeak + John Andrews & The Yawns

events.description: Jack Savoretti's warm, retro singer-songwriter pop is ideal date-night listening. Kaufleuten bills this as his sole Swiss show, so expect demand. Central location near Paradeplatz.
events.summary: Velvet-voiced English-Italian crooner Jack Savoretti's only Swiss show, in cosy Kaufleuten.
events.title: Jack Savoretti

events.description: On 31 Dec 2026 groups of 'schöne', 'wüeschte' and 'schö-wüeschte' Chläuse roam Urnäsch and neighbouring villages from early morning, ringing heavy bells and singing wordless Zäuerli yodels. Best seen in the village in the morning; dress warmly. It repeats on the 'old' New Year's Eve, 13 Jan 2027.
events.summary: Masked 'Chläuse' in giant headdresses and huge bells yodel from farm to farm from dawn – utterly unique.
events.title: Silvesterchlausen, Urnäsch (New Year's Eve)

events.description: The Ugandan-British songwriter's delicate, Nick Drake-like folk in the last building Le Corbusier designed, right on the lake in Seefeld. Tiny capacity and a museum-piece venue make this a true gem, minutes from Küsnacht.
events.priceText: Price TBA · on sale via Songkick link
events.summary: Hushed folk from Daudi Matsiko inside Le Corbusier's colourful lakeside pavilion — a one-of-a-kind setting.
events.title: Daudi Matsiko at Pavillon Le Corbusier

events.description: A tribute to John Lennon's songs. It plays 22, 23 and 26 Dec, so it makes a festive outing between the holidays.
events.summary: Imagine a Christmas-week singalong of Beatles and Lennon classics above the city lights.
events.title: Here Today – Tribute to John Lennon

events.description: Nora Steiner and Madlaina Pollina write warm, sharp indie-folk songs. It's a club show at Salzhaus Winterthur, doors 20:00.
events.summary: Swiss indie-folk duo with gorgeous harmonies in German and English.
events.title: Steiner & Madlaina

events.description: Grönemeyer has been filling arenas since his 1984 breakthrough 'Bochum'. Expect a long, passionate set. Lyrics in German.
events.summary: Germany's biggest rock-poet ('Männer', 'Mensch') — an emotional, huge-singalong arena night.
events.title: Herbert Grönemeyer

events.description: The ATP 500 indoor tournament is the last big stop before the ATP Finals in Turin and draws around 60,000 spectators to St. Jakobshalle. Early-round day sessions are the best value for kids. Tickets via Ticketcorner.
events.priceText: Price TBA · day passes via Ticketcorner
events.summary: Switzerland's biggest sporting event: top-10 tennis in St. Jakobshalle, an easy day trip by train.
events.title: Swiss Indoors Basel (ATP 500)

events.description: Basel's Anna Rossinelli brings her Heat tour to the small Kulturkarussell stage in Stäfa's old Rössli inn. Discounts for AHV and students. She also plays Papiersaal Zürich on 21 Nov.
events.summary: Swiss soul-pop singer (Eurovision 2011) in a village culture house 15 minutes down the lake.
events.title: Anna Rossinelli – Heat Tour

events.description: The Tonhalle-Orchester Zürich's family series pairs Tchaikovsky's score with dancers from the Junior Ballet Zürich, conducted by Julia Kurzydlak. Two shows, 11:15 and 14:15. Only remaining tickets ('Restkarten') are left, so book soon.
events.summary: Tchaikovsky's Sleeping Beauty with the Tonhalle orchestra and Junior Ballet dancers — a magical first orchestra concert.
events.title: Family Concert: Sleeping Beauty (Tonhalle-Orchester)

events.description: An Opernhaus 'Musikgeschichten' production for young children (4+), running 5–13 June 2027 – a fun, very Swiss first-music-theatre experience. Followed by 'Die Werkstatt der Schmetterlinge' (8+) from 19 June.
events.priceText: CHF 18 (Musikgeschichten price) · not yet on sale
events.summary: Heidi meets the famous Swiss ibexes Gian & Giachen in a musical story for kids from 4.
events.title: Heidi, Gian & Giachen – Musical Story

events.description: Pierangelo Valtinoni's fairy-tale opera returns to the Opernhaus from 8 November 2026 to 17 January 2027, mostly at 11:00, 13:00 or 14:00 matinees. About 2 hours including an interval; recommended from 7. Sung in German with German and English surtitles. Kids' tickets from CHF 13.
events.summary: Follow the White Rabbit at the Zurich Opera House – a colourful family opera with English surtitles.
events.title: Alice im Wunderland – Family Opera

events.description: Montreux's lakeside market runs 20 Nov–24 Dec 2026; the flying Santa soars over the quay daily at 17:00, 18:00 and 19:00 (plus 16:00 at weekends), free to watch. Santa's train to Rochers-de-Naye leaves hourly 9:00–16:00 (Wed–Sun and selected days): CHF 49 adults, CHF 19 kids 6–15, under-6 free. Best as an overnight trip.
events.priceText: Market free; Santa's train CHF 49 adults / CHF 19 kids
events.summary: Watch Santa fly his sleigh over Lake Geneva, then ride a cogwheel train to his house at 2,042 m.
events.title: Montreux Noël & Santa's House on Rochers-de-Naye

events.description: The 2027 Theater Spektakel runs 19 Aug–5 Sept 2027 on the Landiwiese by the lake in Wollishofen. Grounds are free, with free outdoor performances, kids' shows and food stalls; ticketed international theatre and dance, many shows language-neutral or with English surtitles. The free ZKB shuttle boat is a lovely way to arrive.
events.summary: Free-entry lakeside festival grounds full of street theatre, food stalls and international shows at Landiwiese.
events.title: Zürcher Theater Spektakel 2027

events.description: Yesh! screens international and Israeli features and documentaries with guest talks, across Zurich's Riffraff, Houdini and Le Paris cinemas. The 2026 edition ran 19–25 March, so the 2027 edition is expected in mid/late March; dates not yet announced. Most films have German/English subtitles.
events.priceText: CHF 22 per film, galas CHF 26 (2026 rates)
events.summary: A week of new Jewish and Israeli cinema at the Riffraff and Houdini arthouses, with director Q&As.
events.title: Yesh! Jewish Film Days Zürich 2027

events.description: Noah Kahan's banjo-and-heartbreak folk-pop has made him one of the biggest new live acts; Mon Rovîa opens. Hallenstadion, Oerlikon. A great one to take an older kid to.
events.summary: 'Stick Season' folk-pop phenomenon Noah Kahan — a stadium-size sing-along that parents and teens both love.
events.title: Noah Kahan

events.description: Just four days: Thu 3 Dec (13:30–22:00), Fri–Sat 4–5 Dec (11:00–22:00) and Sun 6 Dec 2026 (11:00–18:00). Crafts, food and a riverside old town lit up for the season. Go early on Friday to dodge Saturday crowds; 35 minutes from Zurich by S-Bahn via Dietikon.
events.summary: 300+ stalls fill a car-free medieval town on the Reuss – one of Switzerland's largest Christmas markets.
events.title: Bremgarten Weihnachts- und Christchindli-Märt

events.description: Fantoche's 25th anniversary edition runs 7–12 Sept 2027 in Baden, 20 minutes from Zurich. Expect competitions, family and kids' programmes, workshops and outdoor screenings. Animation is largely language-light, great for all ages.
events.priceText: CHF 18 per screening (kids CHF 12), pass CHF 170 (2026 rates)
events.summary: Baden fills with animated films, kids' screenings and open-air projections for its 25th edition.
events.title: Fantoche 2027 – International Animation Festival

events.description: Johnny Borrell's Razorlight celebrate 20 years of their UK No. 1 'America'. Kammgarn is a converted wool-spinning mill on the Rhine in Schaffhausen, about 40 minutes by train from Zurich.
events.summary: 'America' and 'Somewhere Else' on a 20th-anniversary tour, in a historic Schaffhausen wool mill.
events.title: Razorlight

events.description: The British boy band still tour their early-2000s chart hits with plenty of harmonies and sing-alongs. Halle 622 is a former industrial hall in Zurich-Oerlikon. A fun, light-hearted night out.
events.summary: Noughties boy band Blue ('All Rise', 'One Love') bring pure nostalgia to Halle 622 in Oerlikon.
events.title: Blue

events.description: Lucerne Fasnacht starts at 05:00 on 'Schmutziger Donnerstag' (4 Feb 2027) with the Urknall, and peaks with the big parades on Thursday and Güdismontag (8 Feb). Daytime parades are very family-friendly: dress the kids up and bring confetti. Ear protection recommended for little ones.
events.summary: Six days of Guggenmusik, giant masks and confetti in Lucerne's old town – Switzerland's most colourful carnival.
events.title: Luzerner Fasnacht

events.description: Gurtenfestival 2027 runs 14–18 July on Bern's Gurten hill, and you arrive by funicular. No 2027 acts have been announced yet (2026 had Lorde, Lily Allen and Kraftklub). Tickets from about CHF 121.
events.summary: Bern's house-mountain festival, reached by funicular, with big indie and pop acts and city views.
events.title: Gurtenfestival 2027

events.description: Laura-Mary Carter and Steven Ansell have made scuzzy two-piece indie rock since the mid-2000s. Plaza is a compact club on Badenerstrasse, so you'll be close to the stage.
events.summary: Brighton's guitar-and-drums duo: loud, tight 2000s indie rock in a sweaty club.
events.title: Blood Red Shoes

events.description: ZEST presents RENT on 27–28 Nov (plus 28 Nov 14:00 matinee) and 1–5 Dec 2026 at 19:30, at The Millers in the Mühle Tiefenbrunnen, one stop from Küsnacht. Runtime about 2h40 incl. interval. Themes suit teens and adults.
events.summary: Zurich's English-speaking theatre stages Jonathan Larson's rock musical in Seefeld – a great date night.
events.title: RENT – 30th Anniversary (ZEST English Theatre)

events.description: Richard Strauss's Elektra gets a new production at Opernhaus Zürich under conductor Lorenzo Viotti. It's short, overwhelming and orchestrally thrilling, a strong pick for a parents' night out. Surtitles are available.
events.summary: Date night: Strauss's blazing one-act Elektra, conducted by Lorenzo Viotti, 100 intense minutes.
events.title: Elektra – new production (premiere)

events.description: Scottish singer Maggie Reilly sang Mike Oldfield's 80s classics 'Moonlight Shadow' and 'To France' before her solo hit 'Everytime We Touch'. She plays a club show at Salzhaus Winterthur.
events.summary: The voice of 'Moonlight Shadow' and 'To France': 80s nostalgia up close.
events.title: Maggie Reilly

events.description: Rigiblick narrates Bradbury in German with Pink Floyd's classic album played live.
events.summary: Ray Bradbury's stories meet 'The Dark Side of the Moon', played live in a small theatre.
events.title: To the Dark Side of the Moon – Bradbury & Pink Floyd

events.description: The Landesmuseum courtyard lights up 5 Nov–30 Dec 2026 (closed 24–25 Dec) with YUKI light shows (Arctic Christmas, Pixel Zoo Jungle) and an Art × Electronica Paul Klee mapping. Free ILLU.KIDS disco on Sundays 15:00–17:00; plaza entry is free. Opens 17:00 in Nov, 16:45 in Dec, 15:00 Sundays.
events.priceText: Plaza free; shows from CHF 9.90, evening ticket CHF 23.90; under 6 free
events.summary: Light shows projected on the museum's castle facade, a fondue chalet and a free Sunday kids' disco.
events.title: ILLUMINARIUM Christmas Light Festival

events.description: The 71st Adelboden Ski Days: men's giant slalom on Saturday 9 January and slalom on Sunday 10 January (runs at 10:30 and 13:30). The finish arena has standing room and grandstands. Tickets go on sale on 14 October 2026, and VIP tents typically sell out by late November.
events.summary: The world's toughest giant slalom, cowbells and 35,000 fans in a steep alpine amphitheatre.
events.title: Ski World Cup Adelboden (Chuenisbärgli)

events.description: The lakeside road between Zurich, Rapperswil-Jona and Schmerikon is closed to motor traffic for a day of slow mobility. Join anywhere along the route, ride as far as you like and hop on a lake boat back; bike rentals are available at Meilen. Stands along the way sell food and seasonal treats, and there is no racing.
events.summary: 42 km of the right-shore Seestrasse closed to cars: bike, skate or scoot the Gold Coast as a family.
events.title: slowUp Zürichsee – car-free lake road
events.venue: Seestrasse, right shore of Lake Zurich

events.description: A country tribute that tells the story of Johnny Cash and June Carter through their songs. Further dates: 24 Oct, 26 and 27 Nov.
events.summary: Walk the line: the Man in Black's story and songs, sung live in a 200-seat theatre.
events.title: Tribute to Johnny Cash & June Carter

events.description: Switzerland's classic winter city run loops from Limmatquai via Rennweg, Bahnhofstrasse and the old-town lanes past the Christmas lights. There are categories for children, families, duos and groups, and the jubilee edition promises special surprises. Register online, as the kids' categories fill up.
events.priceText: CHF 25–55 until 27 Oct (8.5 km CHF 46, kids CHF 25); rises later
events.summary: Run through Christmas-lit Zurich on its 50th anniversary, with categories for kids, duos and whole families.
events.title: 50th Zürcher Silvesterlauf

events.description: Basel's Christmas market runs from late November to 23 Dec 2026 on Barfüsserplatz and Münsterplatz, with the old town strung with lights down Freie Strasse. Try Basler Läckerli and Glühwein. Exact 2026 opening day not yet published; late-November Thursday opening assumed.
events.summary: Around 150 chalets at Barfüsserplatz and under the Münster – often voted Switzerland's prettiest market.
events.title: Basler Weihnachtsmarkt

events.description: Moon+Stars 2027 (15–25 July) puts Take That on the Piazza Grande on Saturday 17 July, sharing the bill with Tokio Hotel. Public sale opens Monday 28 September 2026 at 12:00 (pre-access available now), and these typically go fast. Make a Ticino weekend of it.
events.priceText: Standard / Golden Circle / VIP; Moon+Stars tickets from approx. CHF 110
events.summary: Take That under the stars on Locarno's Piazza Grande — the ultimate 90s singalong on a Ticino summer night.
events.title: Take That at Moon+Stars Locarno

events.description: Josef and Jan Prasil (Czech-Australian roots, raised in Italy) play Mediterranean-tinged harmony folk. It's in Kaufleuten's Klubsaal with support from Orange Oak. The 1 Nov show goes by ticket draw; this 2 Nov show is on normal sale.
events.summary: German-Australian twin brothers with close-harmony folk. Seated tickets make it a relaxed date night.
events.title: Amistat

events.description: Triggerfinger play heavy, groovy rock, and their acoustic Lykke Li cover became a surprise hit. Albani is a cramped, atmospheric old-town club in Winterthur.
events.summary: Belgium's sharp-suited rock trio, famous for their stripped-back 'I Follow Rivers' cover.
events.title: Triggerfinger

events.description: Hecht ('Kawasaki', 'Besch ready für die Liebi?') are the feel-good Swiss-German band of the moment, and this Letzigrund date is the only stadium concert announced there so far for 2027. Open-air in June; great with kids who hear them on Swiss radio.
events.summary: Swiss pop band Hecht's first stadium show — a giant Züri summer singalong for the whole family.
events.title: Hecht at Stadion Letzigrund

events.description: Familienclub Erlenbach organises an annual early-November lantern parade from behind the Erlibacherhof through the village to the Alterszentrum Gehren, where the children sing. Free snacks and drinks for kids; LED lights sold at the start for CHF 2. The 2026 date is not yet published – it is usually the first Saturday in November at 17:30, so check the Familienclub page.
events.summary: Neighbouring Erlenbach's intimate turnip-lantern walk, ending with songs and treats for the kids.
events.title: Räbeliechtliumzug Erlenbach

events.description: Jeffrey Lewis switches between raw acoustic folk and garage-punk, often with illustrated 'low-budget films' drawn by hand. He tours his 2025 album 'The Even More Freewheelin' Jeffrey Lewis' on Halloween night.
events.summary: New York anti-folk hero and comic artist, Ben Gibbard's 'favourite contemporary songwriter'.
events.title: Jeffrey Lewis & The Voltage

events.description: South African Matthew Mole writes acoustic-driven alt-pop. Dynamo's Saal is a mid-small room by the Limmat at Drahtschmidli.
events.summary: South African singer-songwriter with warm, heartfelt acoustic pop.
events.title: Matthew Mole

events.description: Part of the Swiss Käsefeste series, the Lucerne edition fills the Kapellplatz by the Chapel Bridge with traditional and innovative cheeses from the region. Kids can watch cheese being made and try cow milking. Entry is free. Combine it with a walk along the Reuss.
events.summary: A free cheese festival on Lucerne's Kapellplatz with regional cheeses, cow-milking demos and cheese-making to watch.
events.title: Käsefest Luzern

events.address: Swiss shore of Lake Constance, Thurgau
events.description: A late-summer slowUp on the Swiss shore of Lake Constance, one of the flattest routes in the series and so ideal for younger riders. There are food stands in the villages along the way, and you can swim at a lake beach afterwards.
events.summary: Flat, car-free lakeside roads along Lake Constance, perfect for kids on bikes, scooters or inline skates.
events.title: slowUp Bodensee Schweiz

events.description: The Montreux Jazz Festival 2027 runs 2–17 July, with dates listed but no line-up yet. Beyond the paid headliner halls there are free lakeside stages and food stalls, which work well as a family day trip. Line-up usually drops in spring and big names sell out fast.
events.priceText: Price TBA · tickets ~April 2027; free lakeside stages
events.summary: Legendary lakeside festival on Lake Geneva: big-name concerts plus free stages, boat parties and sunsets.
events.title: Montreux Jazz Festival 2027

events.description: Now in its 33rd year, this friendly Winterthur run has no online registration. Sign up in person on the day (9:30am–2:30pm) and start whenever you like on 4, 7 or 10 km loops, with categories for kids. It's 5 minutes from Oberwinterthur station, so the whole family can run and then have a warm drink.
events.priceText: CHF 15 adults, CHF 10 families/seniors, CHF 5 juniors (pay on the day)
events.summary: A low-key family run: no mass start, pick 4, 7 or 10 km and set off whenever you're ready.
events.title: Hegemer Chlauslauf

events.description: Engelberg combines its cattle descent and autumn market on 26 Sept 2026. Expect decorated herds, local cheese, crafts and alpine food in the village streets. Direct trains via Lucerne make it an easy car-free outing.
events.summary: Cows come home to the Titlis valley while the village throws its autumn market – easy day trip from Zurich.
events.title: Engelberg Alpabzug & Herbstmarkt

events.description: Jaël and Lunik, the Bernese band from 2000s Swiss radio, play the small Kulturkarussell in Stäfa. They also play Kammgarn Schaffhausen on 13 Nov.
events.summary: Swiss 2000s pop favourites Lunik in a village hall on the Gold Coast.
events.title: Lunik – Cycle Breaker Tour

events.description: UK singer-songwriter Morgan Harper-Jones plays intimate folk-pop with a clear, fragile voice. The early 19:00 Sunday start means you're home at a reasonable hour.
events.summary: Delicate British folk-pop on a Sunday evening in Winterthur's old-town club.
events.title: Morgan Harper-Jones

events.description: Nik Kershaw's 80s hits tour lands at Kaufleuten at 20:00, the night after Level 42 — an 80s double weekend if you're up for it. Intimate standing/seated club setting.
events.summary: 'Wouldn't It Be Good' and 'The Riddle' — 80s pop hero Nik Kershaw up close at Kaufleuten.
events.title: Nik Kershaw

events.description: A quirky old Zurich Easter custom: on Easter Monday morning children stand under the Limmatquai arcades and at Rüdenplatz holding coloured eggs, and adults try to lodge a 20-cent coin in the shell. Miss, and the kids keep your coin. Bring a basket of hard-boiled eggs and a pocket of Zwänzgerli.
events.summary: Kids hold up hard-boiled eggs, adults throw 20-rappen coins at them – whoever sticks the coin wins the egg!
events.title: Zwänzgerle – Easter Monday Egg Tradition

events.description: Wildnispark Zürich runs an evening guided walk through Langenberg Wildlife Park as the animals become active at dusk, followed by a seasonal autumn meal. A family-friendly one-off in the Sihl valley, 30 minutes from Küsnacht. Registration via the Wildnispark programme page.
events.summary: Wolves, bears and wild boar at dusk with a ranger, then a warming autumn meal – a proper forest adventure.
events.title: Twilight Tour with Autumn Feast at Wildnispark Langenberg

events.description: Lou Rhodes, singer of 90s Manchester trip-hop duo Lamb, fronts the UK project Kiiōtō. Bogen F sits in one of the Viadukt arches in Kreis 5.
events.summary: The voice of Lamb's 90s trip-hop anthem 'Gorecki', in a club under the railway arches.
events.title: Kiiōtō feat. Lou Rhodes (of Lamb)

events.description: In Küssnacht am Rigi (not our Küsnacht!) over 1,500 men parade through the dark streets at 20:15 with towering illuminated 'Iffelen' lanterns, cowbells, horns and Samichlaus himself; up to 30,000 people watch. Loud and atmospheric – best for kids 6+, with ear protection for little ones. Go early by train.
events.summary: 200 glowing giant mitre-lanterns, 1,000 cowbell ringers and whip-crackers – Switzerland's most spectacular St. Nicholas night.
events.title: Küssnachter Klausjagen

events.description: Von Goisern reinvented Alpine folk music in the 90s ('Koa Hiatamadl') and remains a thrilling live act. Show 20:00 at Volkshaus, presented by AllBlues. Dialect lyrics, but the music speaks for itself.
events.summary: Austria's alpine-folk-rock rebel Hubert von Goisern mixes yodel, accordion and rock — pure Alpenrock magic.
events.title: Hubert von Goisern

events.description: Seewis im Prättigau hosts its Alp Spektakel on 3–4 Oct 2026 with more than 100 decorated cattle, livestock competitions and a festival. Pair it with a hike above the Prättigau valley. About 1h30 from Zurich.
events.summary: A whole weekend of 100+ flower-decked cattle, livestock contests and a Graubünden village party.
events.title: Prättigauer Alp Spektakel, Seewis

events.description: Axel Bosse's warm, anthemic German-language pop-rock sounds great in Dynamo's compact Saal by the Limmat.
events.summary: German singer-songwriter with big-hearted anthems ('Schönste Zeit') in a club setting.
events.title: Bosse

events.description: Küsnacht's Kunsteisbahn KEK opens on Sat 24 October 2026 and runs until 7 March 2027. The open field ('Schlittschüendle') is open daily for public skating (weekends 09:00–18:45, weekday afternoons), and the ice hall has afternoon sessions plus Wednesday evenings to 21:30. The easiest after-school winter activity for Gold Coast kids.
events.priceText: Price TBA (2026/27 price list on KEK page)
events.summary: Your home rink: public skating in Küsnacht from late October, open-air ice plus an indoor hall.
events.title: KEK Küsnacht Ice Rink Season Opens

events.description: Bastian Kraft directs a new stage version of L. Frank Baum's classic at the Schauspielhaus Pfauen, premiering 24 October with further dates on 26 Oct, 1, 6, 10, 12, 21 and 25 November. In German, but the story is so familiar kids follow easily. Book early for weekend shows.
events.summary: Dorothy, the Tin Man and the yellow brick road on the Pfauen stage – Schauspielhaus's big family show of the season.
events.title: Der Zauberer von Oz at Schauspielhaus Zürich

events.description: At the Lindt Home of Chocolate, the 90-minute Christmas Special course lets you cast a hollow chocolate figure and decorate pralines. Children 5–12 can join with an accompanying adult (both need tickets). Seasonal dates appear in the online booking system – book well ahead, it sells out. Just across the lake from Küsnacht.
events.summary: Cast and decorate your own chocolate Christmas figure with Lindt master chocolatiers in Kilchberg.
events.title: Lindt Christmas Special Chocolate Course

events.description: Devon Allman guides the audience through his solo catalogue and the Allman Brothers Band songbook, with a different setlist each night. Doors 19:00, show 20:00, ends around 22:30.
events.summary: Gregg Allman's son plays his own songs plus Allman Brothers classics.
events.title: The Devon Allman Project – An Allman Experience

events.description: Dylan's shows lean on reworked classics and late-career material, typically phone-free. Show 20:00 at Hallenstadion. For folk fans this is a once-in-a-lifetime ticket.
events.summary: A chance to see the Nobel laureate and folk-rock legend Bob Dylan live — possibly one of his last tours.
events.title: Bob Dylan

events.description: Pro Velo Kanton Zürich's bike swap on Helvetiaplatz has city bikes, mountain bikes, e-bikes and a large choice of children's bikes. Drop-off for sellers is 8–10am and sales run 9am–3pm. Bikes not being sold get a free check-up. Arrive early for the best kids' bikes.
events.summary: Zurich's big second-hand bike market, the place to size kids up to their next bike, with free safety checks.
events.title: Pro Velo Bike Market (Velobörse) Helvetiaplatz

events.description: Lucerne's big autumn fair spreads across Bahnhofplatz, Europaplatz (by the KKL) and the lakeside Inseli: 57 ride operators including a children's train, carousels, a new wheelchair-accessible Ferris wheel and thrill rides, plus 81 market stalls. On Family Day (Thu 15 Oct) rides are half price until 19:00. Luna-Park opens 11:00 daily (10:00 on opening day).
events.priceText: Free entry; rides paid (half price 15 Oct until 19:00)
events.summary: Sixteen days of Luna-Park rides on the Lucerne lakefront, with half-price rides on Family Day, 15 October.
events.title: Lozärner Määs – Lucerne Autumn Fair

events.description: On Monday 23 Nov 2026 over 200 stalls fill Bern's old town from 6:00 with artful onion and garlic braids, Zibelechueche, onion soup and Glühwein. Locals arrive before dawn; later in the day kids join the confetti fun with squeaky hammers. A school day, so plan a day off; 1h by train from Zurich.
events.summary: 50 tons of braided onions, onion tart for breakfast and a confetti-filled old town – Bern's wildest Monday.
events.title: Zibelemärit – Bern Onion Market

events.description: Richterswil's legendary Räbechilbi fills the old village with market stalls and concerts from 3pm, and the lantern parade starts at 6pm (about an hour). A festival badge (CHF 10–15, cash) is compulsory. Leave strollers at home and take the S2/S8 along the left shore.
events.summary: The world's largest turnip-lantern parade: about 40 glowing floats carved from thousands of turnips.
events.title: Räbechilbi Richterswil

events.description: Charmey's Désalpe on 26 Sept 2026 brings decorated herds down through the village from roughly 9:00 to 17:00, with market stalls, cheese and folk music. Arrive by 9:30 for parking or go by train/bus via Bulle. Combine with Gruyères castle or the cheese dairy nearby.
events.summary: One of Switzerland's most famous cattle descents: flower-crowned cows, armaillis and a Gruyère village fair.
events.title: Désalpe de Charmey

events.description: The 22nd ZFF runs 24 Sept–4 Oct 2026 with competition films, gala premieres, free ZFF Talks at the Festival Centre on Sechseläutenplatz, and Cinema in Concert with the Tonhalle Orchestra. ZFF for Kids screens children's films (foreign films with live German translation) with a Kids Jury aged 10–13. Many main-section films screen in original version with English subtitles.
events.priceText: Single tickets approx. CHF 15–25; ZFF Talks free
events.summary: Green carpet, gala premieres and a dedicated ZFF for Kids section, right in town until 4 October.
events.title: Zurich Film Festival (ZFF) 2026

events.description: Fink's slow-burning acoustic grooves are made for a small, attentive room. Angela Autumn opens. Kaufleuten is central and easy to reach by tram from Stadelhofen.
events.summary: Fin Greenall's hypnotic blues-folk (Ninja Tune's Fink) in the velvet setting of Kaufleuten.
events.title: Fink

events.description: Zurich's Fasnacht weekend brings Guggenmusik bands, parades and a heated marquee on Hirschenplatz to the old town, 12–14 February 2027. Daytime parades and the Guggen concerts suit costumed kids; evenings are for adults. For a smaller local option, the Entlisberg Kinderhausfasnacht parade (Wollishofen) offers face painting and a Guggen-led kids' parade.
events.summary: Zurich's own carnival weekend: Guggen bands, costumed parades and confetti in the Niederdorf.
events.title: ZüriCarneval

events.description: One of the traditional autumn village fairs in the Zurich lake region, with rides, snack stands and stalls across the weekend. Easy by bus from Meilen or Männedorf. Ideal for younger kids who find the big city fairs overwhelming.
events.summary: Small-village Chilbi above Lake Zurich – carousels, sweets and a proper local atmosphere without the crowds.
events.title: Chilbi Oetwil am See

events.description: Every evening choirs (many of them children's choirs) perform on the tiered 'Singing Christmas Tree' on Werdmühleplatz, just off Bahnhofstrasse. Performances Mon–Thu 17:30 & 18:30, Fri also 19:30, weekends 14:30, 15:30, 17:30 & 18:30. Free entry; the Chinder-Karussell costs CHF 3 a ride and a fondue chalet serves from 17:00.
events.summary: Children's choirs sing from a giant tree-shaped stage on Werdmühleplatz – free, plus a CHF 3 kids' carousel.
events.title: The Singing Christmas Tree & Wiehnachtsmärt

events.description: The Tonhalle-Orchester Zürich under chief conductor Paavo Järvi, with Japanese pianist Hayato Sumino in Prokofiev's Piano Concerto No. 3. Also on the programme are Prokofiev's Symphony No. 4 and Dieter Ammann's 'Turn'. Performances run 4–6 November at 7:30pm.
events.summary: Date night at the golden Tonhalle: YouTube piano star Hayato Sumino plays Prokofiev's Third with Paavo Järvi.
events.title: Tonhalle: Paavo Järvi & Hayato Sumino – Prokofiev

events.description: The historic Dolder Kunsteisbahn opens its 2026/27 season on 17 October and runs until 7 March 2027. Public skating Mon–Sat 09:00–22:30 (Wed to 20:00, Sun to 17:45), plus curling, ice discos with live DJs and fondue gondolas. Skate rental on site; reach it by tram and Dolderbahn.
events.priceText: Kids 6–15 CHF 4, youth CHF 6, adults CHF 8
events.summary: Skate in the forest above Zurich on one of Europe's biggest open-air rinks – take the Dolderbahn up.
events.title: Dolder Open-Air Ice Rink Season Opens

events.description: The Familienzentrum Küsnacht's lantern procession starts at the Dorfplatz and winds through the village to a large fire on the lakeshore, with music from the Harmonie Eintracht and food and drinks (Glühwein, punch, hot dogs, raclette). Carve your turnip lantern the day before (Fri 6 Nov, 14:00–17:00) at the Familienzentrum.
events.summary: Küsnacht's own lantern parade ending at a big bonfire by the lake, with raclette, hot dogs and punch.
events.title: Räbeliechtli-Umzug Küsnacht

events.description: The Amsterdam trio have been making elegant, Bowie-influenced art-pop since the late 70s, with a devoted Swiss following. Kaufleuten's intimate hall suits their detailed sound.
events.summary: Dutch art-pop cult band NITS ('In the Dutch Mountains') — a thoughtful, beautiful 80s-rooted club show.
events.title: NITS

events.description: The traditional Märlitram runs daily in Advent from Bellevue via Limmatquai, Central and Bahnhofstrasse (about 20 min), with angels reading Christmas stories to children aged 4–9 (children only). 2026 dates are expected from 21 November; tickets sell online from mid-November and go very fast.
events.priceText: CHF 12 per child (last year's price) · on sale mid-Nov
events.summary: Santa drives a vintage tram through Zurich while two angels read Christmas stories – pure magic for 4–9s.
events.title: St. Annahof Märlitram (Fairy-Tale Tram)

events.description: Matt Bellamy and co. bring their new Wow! Signal tour for two Zurich nights (7 and 8 December). Expect a massive production and hits from 'Plug In Baby' to 'Uprising'. Great with teens.
events.summary: Muse's sci-fi stadium-rock spectacle squeezed into Hallenstadion — two nights of lasers and huge riffs.
events.title: Muse — The Wow! Signal Europa Tour

events.description: Silvesterzauber on 31 Dec 2026 fills the Seebecken with food areas, stages (incl. a 90s Bash stage), a Raclette zone and a Happy Kids Zone, culminating in the big lake fireworks after midnight. Public areas are free; a paid VIP Magic Lake Zone has the best view. Very crowded – consider watching from the Küsnacht shore instead.
events.summary: Switzerland's biggest NYE party around the lake basin with a spectacular fireworks show and a Happy Kids Zone.
events.title: Silvesterzauber – Zurich New Year's Eve & Fireworks

events.description: The Verkehrshaus in Lucerne runs themed Air and Space Days on top of its huge permanent aviation and space halls, planetarium and hands-on outdoor area. Pair it with the current interactive exhibitions 'Experience Energy!' and 'Really?!'. Plan 4+ hours; the Swiss Chocolate Adventure ride is on site too.
events.priceText: Museum entry CHF 37 (kids CHF 16, under 6 free)
events.summary: Rockets, planes and space themes take over Switzerland's favourite museum for aspiring pilots and astronauts.
events.title: Air and Space Days at the Swiss Museum of Transport

events.description: On Sunday 4 Oct 2026 Elm's market opens around 8:00 with alp cheese and Glarus Schabziger, followed by herds coming down from the Sernftal alps. Close to Zurich (about 1h15) and dramatic scenery under the Tschingelhörner.
events.summary: Glarus cows descend into car-free-feeling Elm with an alpine cheese and Schabziger market from 8am.
events.title: Elm Alpabzug & Schabziger Market

events.description: The Zurich Film Festival runs its first-ever Family Day in the festival centre on Sechseläutenplatz. Children's films play through the day (e.g. Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom, Mumbo Jumbo), plus play and activity stations. Free and no registration; foreign films for kids are usually dubbed in German.
events.summary: Free kids' films, games and fun in the ZFF festival village on Sechseläutenplatz – no cinema ticket needed.
events.title: ZFF Family Day at the Zurich Film Festival

events.description: Circus Monti's 2026 tour ends with its longest run in Zurich (26 performances, 4–29 Nov) on the Kasernenareal, after a stop in Winterthur (Teuchelweiher, 28 Oct–1 Nov). Shows run about 140 minutes including a 20-minute interval, with numbered cushioned seats. A circus restaurant operates on site; tickets open six weeks before each stop.
events.summary: Switzerland's most artistic family circus pitches its big top in the Kasernenareal for its final 2026 stop.
events.title: Circus Monti in Zurich

events.description: Singer and comedian Dodo Hug brings her multilingual songs and cabaret to a final 'Dodologie' show on the Gold Coast.
events.summary: Farewell tour of a Swiss cabaret-song legend, at the Rössli in Stäfa.
events.title: Dodo Hug – Dodologie Dernière

events.description: The 30th edition runs 3–8 Nov 2026 across Winterthur cinemas and venues, with international competition, themed programmes, concerts and readings. Short films are ideal for mixed-attention audiences; most are subtitled in English. 20 minutes by train from Zurich.
events.priceText: CHF 18 single (kids CHF 10), pass CHF 125 · on sale 14 Oct
events.summary: Switzerland's major short-film festival turns 30 – bite-size cinema, concerts and a buzzing old town.
events.title: 30th Internationale Kurzfilmtage Winterthur

events.description: Rigiblick's house tribute to The Boss, with a live band playing the big Springsteen songs in a roughly 200-seat room. Only about 13 tickets were left when checked. It repeats on 14 Nov.
events.summary: Springsteen anthems in Zurich's cosiest hilltop theatre, reached by the Seilbahn Rigiblick funicular.
events.title: Born to Run – Tribute to Bruce Springsteen

events.description: Lake Street Dive blend indie pop, Motown soul and jazz harmonies into a feel-good live show. Kaufleuten's Klubsaal is an elegant, compact room in the city centre, perfect for a date night. Show 20:00, presented by AllBlues.
events.summary: Boston's joyful indie-soul band with Rachael Price's gorgeous voice in Kaufleuten's plush ballroom.
events.title: Lake Street Dive

events.description: Theater Rigiblick narrates Poe's story in German between live Pink Floyd music. For more Floyd, 'To the Dark Side of the Moon' (Bradbury + Pink Floyd) plays on 18 Dec.
events.summary: 'Atom Heart Mother' meets 'The Fall of the House of Usher': prog rock and gothic tales on a Sunday evening.
events.title: Pink Floyd meets Edgar Allan Poe

events.description: JJ Julius Son's howling vocals and the band's folk-blues grit make KALEO a great live draw for indie/folk fans. Halle 622 in Zurich-Oerlikon.
events.summary: Icelandic blues-folk-rock band KALEO ('Way Down We Go') brings raw, bluesy power to Halle 622.
events.title: KALEO

events.description: Aleko, The Miserly Knight and Francesca da Rimini are rarely performed, let alone together. General music director Gianandrea Noseda conducts this new production. Surtitles are in German and English.
events.summary: Date night: Zurich Opera stages all three Rachmaninoff one-acters in a single evening, conducted by Gianandrea Noseda.
events.title: Rachmaninoff – The Three Operas (premiere)

events.description: Opernhaus Zürich's new La traviata premieres on 20 December with star conductor Joana Mallwitz. It's the most accessible opera of the season and a good first opera for teenagers too. Pair it with a stroll through the Bellevue Noël market outside.
events.summary: A festive date night: Verdi's La traviata in a new staging, conducted by Joana Mallwitz, premiering just before Christmas.
events.title: La traviata – new production (premiere)

events.description: Stu Larsen, long-time touring partner of Passenger, writes tender travel-worn folk songs. The Musikcafé at X-TRA near Limmatplatz is a small, seated-and-standing room — a lovely low-key weeknight outing.
events.summary: Australian wandering troubadour Stu Larsen's gentle acoustic folk in X-TRA's intimate café room.
events.title: Stu Larsen at X-TRA Musikcafé

events.description: On Fasnacht Sunday, 14 Feb 2027, around 19:15, participants carry burning pine bundles and pull fire wagons with flames reaching the rooftops through Liestal's Törli gate; around 50,000 watch. There's a daytime carnival parade from 13:45. Heat and crowds are intense – keep kids back from the front. Go straight on to Basel's Morgestraich at 4am if you dare.
events.summary: Blazing pine-torch bundles and fire wagons flame through a medieval old town – jaw-dropping.
events.title: Chienbäse, Liestal

events.description: A tribute to Queen with a live band in Theater Rigiblick's intimate hall. Further dates: 1 Nov (18:00), 20 & 25 Nov, 10–11 Dec and 27 Dec.
events.summary: Freddie's greatest hits belted out live in a tiny theatre above the city.
events.title: Queen – A Night at the Theatre (Tribute)

events.description: The Grammy-nominated young bluesman plays acoustic Piedmont and Delta blues at El Lokal's riverside bar.
events.summary: Taj Mahal's protégé: country blues from Georgia, played with joy and wit.
events.title: Jontavious Willis

events.description: Basel's 'drey scheenschte Dääg' start with the Morgestraich at 4:00 on Monday 15 Feb 2027 and run until Thursday 4am. The Monday and Wednesday afternoon Cortège parades shower kids with oranges and sweets; the lantern exhibition on Münsterplatz (Monday evening to Wednesday) is great for families. Don't wear a costume as a spectator – that's for participants.
events.summary: At 4am every light in Basel goes out and lantern-lit fife-and-drum cliques march – UNESCO heritage magic.
events.title: Basler Fasnacht 2027 – Morgestraich

events.description: Sechseläuten runs 16–19 Apr 2027 with Lucerne as guest canton. The children's parade in costume is on Sunday 18 Apr; on Monday 19 Apr the guild procession winds through the city and the Böögg's head is expected to explode on Sechseläutenplatz at 18:00. Get a spot by the Opera early or watch the parade on Bahnhofstrasse.
events.summary: Zurich's guilds parade on horseback, then gallop round the burning Böögg snowman to predict summer.
events.title: Sechseläuten 2027 (guest canton Lucerne)

events.description: Rod Stewart plays the Piazza Grande on Thursday 22 July 2027 during Moon+Stars. Public sale opens 28 September 2026 at 12:00. Given his farewell-era touring, this may be a last chance.
events.priceText: Standard / Golden Circle / VIP; from approx. CHF 110
events.summary: Sir Rod Stewart's 'Maggie May' to 'Da Ya Think I'm Sexy?' — a legendary showman under Locarno's stars.
events.title: Rod Stewart at Moon+Stars Locarno

events.description: Circus Knie's final 2026 stop is Lucerne, 10 December to 3 January – a festive holiday outing combined with the Lucerne Eiszauber rink. Top international acts, clowns and horse numbers. (Closer to home, Knie also plays Zug on 20–22 November.)
events.summary: Switzerland's national circus ends its 2026 tour with a Christmas-to-New-Year run in Lucerne.
events.title: Circus Knie Christmas Season in Lucerne

events.description: The Kingdom Choir, famous for 'Stand By Me' at Harry and Meghan's wedding, joins Swiss soul singer Jan SEVEN Dettwyler for a Christmas show on 8 and 9 December. An uplifting pre-holiday concert for all ages.
events.summary: The gospel choir from the royal wedding raises the roof with soulful Christmas songs — festive family outing.
events.title: Soul Christmas with Jan SEVEN Dettwyler & The Kingdom Choir

events.description: The 83rd OLMA runs 8–18 Oct 2026 with guest canton Schwyz. Highlights include livestock halls, the famous Säulirennen pig races, a family parcours, tastings and St. Galler Bratwurst. Go on a weekday to avoid the big weekend crowds; direct trains from Zurich take about 1h.
events.priceText: Day tickets approx. CHF 10–20; kids reduced
events.summary: Switzerland's favourite farm & food fair: animals, pig races, bratwurst and a family parcours.
events.title: OLMA St. Gallen 2026

events.description: ABBA Gold recreates the Swedish supergroup's hits with costumes and a live band. Volkshaus in Kreis 4. An easy, joyful family evening out in winter.
events.summary: 'Dancing Queen', 'Mamma Mia', 'Waterloo' — a sparkly ABBA tribute night the kids can dance along to.
events.title: ABBA Gold — tribute show

events.description: Rapperswil's beloved market runs over three weekends (3–6, 9–13 and 17–20 Dec), with the main 200+ stall market 9–13 Dec. Kids get a fairy-tale tent, storytelling, blacksmith demos and candle dipping in the castle-topped old town. Wed–Fri 14:00–21:00, Sat 11:00–21:00, Sun 11:00–19:30. Take the S7 from Küsnacht – about 30 minutes.
events.summary: A fairy-tale medieval old town turned Christmas market, with a story tent, blacksmiths and candle dipping.
events.title: Christkindlimärt Rapperswil-Jona

events.description: The Christmas market lines Einsiedeln's main street up to the Benedictine monastery (27 Nov–6 Dec; 11:00–19:30, Fri–Sat to 21:00). Combine with a monastery tour and the Diorama nativity scene. About 50 minutes from Zurich; the market starts across from the station, so leave the car at home.
events.summary: 140 stalls under the vast Einsiedeln monastery, with a huge tree and angel tours – a beautiful Advent day trip.
events.title: Einsiedeln Christmas Market

events.description: Kakkmaddafakka's cheerful, horn-flecked indie pop is famously fun live. Exil is a compact club at Hardstrasse near Hardbrücke station.
events.summary: Norway's party-starting indie-pop band Kakkmaddafakka in Kreis 5's tiny Exil club — guaranteed dancing.
events.title: Kakkmaddafakka at Exil

events.description: Stäfa's traditional autumn Chilbi fills the village centre by the lake with rides, shooting booths and sweet stalls over the weekend. A short S-Bahn/S7 hop from Küsnacht, it is a relaxed, very local alternative to the big city fairs. Best on Saturday afternoon or Sunday for the kids.
events.summary: Classic lakeside village fun fair on the Gold Coast – bumper cars, carousels, Magenbrot and candy floss.
events.title: Stäfner Chilbi

events.description: Lenk celebrates the end of the alp season on 10 Oct 2026 with traditional Züglete processions, decorated cows and folk music. Combine with a walk to the Simmenfälle waterfalls. Around 2h45 from Zurich, so best as part of a weekend.
events.summary: Züglete processions with decorated animals at the head of the Simmental – a Bernese Oberland gem.
events.title: Älplerfest Lenk

events.description: On 26 Sept 2026 eight separate Appenzell processions leave Steinfluh (from 8:00), Tal and Urnäsch (11:30, 13:30), with herdsmen in traditional costume, goats and bell-cows. Line the road near Urnäsch; times are given without guarantee, so arrive early. About 1h15 from Küsnacht.
events.summary: Eight herds with yodelling Sennen in red waistcoats and huge brass bells walk down from the Säntis alps.
events.title: Alpabfahrten in Appenzellerland (Urnäsch/Steinfluh)
events.venue: Roads between Steinfluh, Tal and Urnäsch

events.description: The 97th Lauberhorn races: super-G on Friday 15 January (with the Patrouille Suisse jet display at 11:20), the famous downhill on Saturday 16 January at 12:30, and slalom on Sunday. More than 40,000 fans attend. Tickets (roughly CHF 65–160) go on sale online only from 8am on 2 November 2026 and include the transfer from Interlaken Ost.
events.summary: The longest World Cup downhill in the Jungfrau region, with a Patrouille Suisse air show over the slope.
events.title: Lauberhorn Races Wengen

events.description: Stans holds its Älperchilbi on Sunday 18 Oct 2026, the herders' festival marking the end of the alp summer. Expect a procession with costumed 'Wildmannli' and 'Wildwyb' figures, speeches in dialect, flag swinging, alphorns and a funfair. An easy 45-minute train ride from Zurich via Lucerne.
events.summary: Nidwalden herders' thanksgiving with Wildmannli, flag-throwing, yodel and a village fair.
events.title: Älperchilbi Stans

events.description: The Ochsner Sport Zürich Marathon offers a full marathon along the lake, a half marathon from Quaibrücke to Sechseläutenplatz, and the On Z10 10k through the city centre. The marathon route runs along the right shore, which makes it easy to cheer from the Gold Coast. Register via GoActive.
events.summary: Run along the lakeshore past the Gold Coast, or cheer on Seestrasse as thousands stream by.
events.title: Zürich Marathon, Half & On Z10 10k

events.description: Jack and the Weatherman are a Dutch indie-folk/pop band with big harmonies and acoustic guitars. It's a club show at Plaza on Badenerstrasse.
events.summary: Dutch brothers with sunny folk-pop and big singalong choruses.
events.title: Jack And The Weatherman

events.description: Zurich's Samichlaus procession runs in the evening from Werdmühleplatz down the illuminated Bahnhofstrasse to Bürkliplatz, with festive floats, the Märlitram and Samichlaus and Schmutzli giving small gifts to children. Free; grab a kerbside spot early.
events.summary: St. Nicholas, Schmutzli, decorated wagons and the Märlitram roll down the lit-up Bahnhofstrasse handing out treats.
events.title: Samichlaus Parade on Bahnhofstrasse

events.description: Gravel Festival Bern has races, relaxed recreational rides, a VCS Family Ride, Kids Gravel events and the Swiss Gravel Championships. There's also an expo village with street food. Registration is open online, and Bern is about an hour by train from Zurich.
events.priceText: CHF 26–83 (kids CHF 12); late fees from 12 Oct
events.summary: Switzerland's biggest gravel-bike day, with a VCS Family Ride and a Kids Gravel so everyone gets muddy.
events.title: Gravel Festival Bern

events.description: Christian McBride brings his contemporary quintet Ursa Major to Moods in Schiffbau, Zurich-West's classic jazz room. Pair it with dinner at the Schiffbau restaurants before the 8:30pm set.
events.summary: Date night: an eight-time Grammy-winning bassist and his young band in Zurich's intimate jazz club.
events.title: Christian McBride & Ursa Major at Moods

events.description: FC Küsnacht's first team hosts FC Hinwil in the regional 3. Liga (Group 6) at the Heslibach sports ground. This is Swiss grassroots football at its most relaxed, a good way to meet neighbours, and ideal if the kids play or want to join the club juniors.
events.priceText: Free / small entry at the gate
events.summary: Village football at Heslibach: Saturday-evening match, sausages at the kiosk and a proper home crowd.
events.title: FC Küsnacht vs FC Hinwil (3. Liga)

events.description: Nannini's 80s hits made her a star across the German-speaking world too, and her Zurich shows draw a big Italian-Swiss crowd. Hallenstadion, autumn 2027.
events.priceText: Price TBA · presale now, general sale 28 Sep
events.summary: Italian rock queen Gianna Nannini ('Bello e impossibile', 'I maschi') — raspy 80s anthems in Hallenstadion.
events.title: Gianna Nannini

events.description: A rare afternoon home game at the Swiss Life Arena, with face-off at 14:00. Ambrì-Piotta's Leventina fans bring great noise and colour. Family packages in sector K1 run from CHF 45 (1+1) to CHF 110 (2 adults + 4 kids).
events.summary: The most kid-friendly hockey slot: a Sunday 2pm game against Ambrì's cult fans, home well before bedtime.
events.title: ZSC Lions vs HC Ambrì-Piotta (Sunday afternoon)

events.description: The ZSC Lions play Lausanne HC in the National League at the Swiss Life Arena in Altstetten. Family tickets in a dedicated family zone (sector K1) cost CHF 45 for 1 adult + 1 child, up to CHF 110 for 2 adults + 4 kids. Children aged 6 and under get in free.
events.summary: Saturday-night hockey at Switzerland's newest arena. Family packages for two adults and four kids cost CHF 110.
events.title: ZSC Lions vs Lausanne HC

events.description: This major Kunsthaus exhibition opens 2 Oct 2026 and runs until 21 Feb 2027, putting Edvard Munch in dialogue with Austrian painter Maria Lassnig. Good for a parents' afternoon or with older kids; under-16s enter free at Kunsthaus. Pair with the Evergreens collection show (until 10 Jan 2027).
events.summary: Kunsthaus Zürich's big winter show pairs Munch's emotional canvases with Lassnig's bold body-painting.
events.title: Maria Lassnig & Edvard Munch: Flow of Paint = Flow of Life

events.description: The Subways had their mid-2000s hit 'Rock & Roll Queen' and are still an energetic live band. Salzhaus is a classic mid-sized club a few minutes from Winterthur station.
events.summary: 'Rock & Roll Queen' live: the UK indie-rock trio in Winterthur's beloved salt-house club.
events.title: The Subways

events.description: Circus Conelli returns to its tent on the Bauschänzli in the Limmat from 21 November to 31 December, with matinees at 14:00 (Wed–Sun) and Saturday evening shows at 19:30. Top acrobatics, poetic numbers and comedy – language-light and great for kids. Book early for December weekends.
events.summary: Zurich's much-loved Christmas circus on the Bauschänzli island: acrobats, clowns and festive magic.
events.title: Circus Conelli – Zurich's Christmas Circus

events.description: FC Zürich host FC Lugano on the weekend of 5–6 December; the Swiss Football League confirms the exact day and kick-off. Wrap up warm, as the Letzigrund is open to the elements.
events.summary: Early-December Super League football at the Letzigrund, a warm-up for the Zurich derby the following weekend.
events.title: FC Zürich vs FC Lugano

events.description: Jonathan Meiburg's cinematic indie-rock band Shearwater headline, with LOMA's dreamy folk-rock in support. Show 20:00. Great value small-venue night.
events.summary: Texan indie triple bill — Shearwater, LOMA and Any Kind — under the Viadukt arches.
events.title: Shearwater + LOMA at Bogen F

events.description: Zurich's cosy family festival spreads through the Mühle Tiefenbrunnen complex: live music on the main stage, circus with Lucy & Lucky Loop, fairy-tale and puppet theatre, and hands-on grinding and baking workshops in the Mühlerama museum (cinnamon rolls for ages 5+). Face painting, crafts and a free syrup fountain. Weatherproof, but it gets busy – come early.
events.summary: A whole mill full of circus acts, puppet theatre, cinnamon-bun baking and face painting – right on the lake in Seefeld.
events.title: EinChorn Family Festival at Mühle Tiefenbrunnen

events.description: ZIID presents a staged reading at the Israelitische Cultusgemeinde Zürich. Voices from a publication explore how belonging, language and memory can be understood plurally. It's a thoughtful Sunday cultural event, in German, for the parents.
events.summary: A staged reading at the Jewish community centre on belonging and home from a post-migrant perspective.
events.title: heimat/home 2.0 – staged reading at ICZ

events.description: Trixie Whitley blends rootsy soul, folk and rock (she was also in Daniel Lanois' Black Dub). Papiersaal is a small, characterful hall in the old paper factory at Sihlcity.
events.summary: Chris Whitley's daughter, a soulful Belgian-American singer-songwriter with a stunning voice.
events.title: Trixie Whitley

events.description: Erlenbach's community music festival returns for its fifth edition over the weekend of 7–8 November. Check the Gemeinde calendar for the programme and venues; it's the same weekend as Erlenbach's own Räbeliechtli procession on 7 November.
events.summary: A small weekend music festival in neighbouring Erlenbach, a village gem that's five minutes from home.
events.title: 5th Erlibacher Music Festival
