events.description: GC host FC Vaduz on the weekend of 31 October–1 November; the exact day and time are confirmed by the Swiss Football League. Easier-to-get tickets make it a relaxed first stadium visit for the kids.
events.priceText: Price TBA (under-16 half price, under-6 free)
events.summary: A Halloween-weekend Super League match: GC against Liechtenstein's FC Vaduz at the Letzigrund.
events.title: Grasshoppers vs FC Vaduz

events.description: Saint-Cergue's Désalpe on 26 Sept 2026 runs roughly 8:00–17:00 with some 700 garlanded cows and 15,000+ visitors. There's a big crafts and food market. Take the scenic Nyon–St-Cergue–Morez train from Nyon.
events.summary: Around 700 decorated cows parade through a Jura village – the biggest cattle descent near Lake Geneva.
events.title: Désalpe de Saint-Cergue

events.description: Bermudian singer-songwriter Heather Nova was a 90s alt-folk favourite. This Bogen F date is sold out; watch Petzi or Ticketcorner for returns.
events.summary: The 90s voice of 'Walk This World' and 'London Rain', sold out in a tiny arch club.
events.title: Heather Nova

events.description: Simply Red play the Piazza Grande on Monday 19 July 2027 as part of Moon+Stars. Public sale opens 28 September 2026 at 12:00. A dreamy open-air date night in Ticino.
events.priceText: Standard / Golden Circle / VIP; from approx. CHF 110
events.summary: Mick Hucknall's 80s soul-pop ('Holding Back the Years', 'Stars') on Locarno's magical Piazza Grande.
events.title: Simply Red at Moon+Stars Locarno

events.description: Zoo Zürich's Zoolino runs a holiday project week for children aged 9–14, five mornings (09:00–12:00) during the Zurich autumn school break. Currently fully booked – worth checking for cancellations or next year's dates.
events.summary: A week of autumn-holiday mornings behind the scenes at Zoo Zürich for animal-mad 9–14 year olds.
events.title: Zoolino Kids Project Week at Zoo Zürich

events.description: Wishbone Ash pioneered the harmony twin-lead guitar sound. Classic-rock heaven in Kammgarn's intimate hall.
events.summary: The twin-guitar 70s rock legends of 'Argus', in an old Schaffhausen mill.
events.title: Wishbone Ash

events.description: Albeuve's cattle descent on Saturday 3 Oct 2026 sees the first herd arrive around 9:00, with festivities continuing through the weekend. Traditional armailli costumes, bells and Gruyère cheese. Small and very local.
events.summary: An intimate Gruyère Désalpe – herds arrive from 9am in a tiny village far from the Charmey crowds.
events.title: Désalpe d'Albeuve

events.description: Tel Aviv pianist-composer Yehezkel Raz plays his melodic, film-score-like solo piano pieces, known to millions from streaming. It's a seated show in the smaller Weisser Saal.
events.summary: Israeli composer-pianist's cinematic, emotional piano in the Volkshaus's intimate Weisser Saal.
events.title: Yehezkel Raz

events.description: FC Zürich host FC Thun in the Brack Super League at the Letzigrund. Sector B seats are the budget option at CHF 25 and main-stand seats cost CHF 50–65. Children under 6 get in free, though without a guaranteed seat. The kick-off time is set by the Swiss Football League.
events.summary: A Saturday Super League match at the Letzigrund, where kids under 6 get in free.
events.title: FC Zürich vs FC Thun

events.description: The lake-neighbour derby against EV Zug at 19:45. Family zone packages in sector K1 start at CHF 45. Book early: derbies sell well.
events.summary: A Saturday-night Zurich–Zug derby, one of the loudest games of the season at the Swiss Life Arena.
events.title: ZSC Lions vs EV Zug

events.description: Singer-actress Nina Dimitri, daughter of the clown Dimitri, joins Silvana Gargiulo and Nicole Knuth for 75 minutes of Italian songs, literature and dance, in two languages and without an interval. Book by phone (044 915 91 43) from 4 Nov.
events.summary: A tragicomic musical road trip to Ticino in Herrliberg's historic Vogtei.
events.title: Nina Dimitri, Silvana Gargiulo & Nicole Knuth – Verso il sole

events.description: Stein am Rhein becomes 'Fairytale Town' from 2 Dec 2026 to 3 Jan 2027, with fairy-tale installations, a Christmas market and illuminated half-timbered facades. Great for younger kids; combine with Rhine Falls on the way. About 1h from Zurich.
events.summary: A painted medieval town turned into a fairytale Christmas village, with story scenes in every window.
events.title: Märlistadt Stein am Rhein

events.description: The Weinbaumuseum am Zürichsee runs an English tour on the history of winegrowing around the lake. It includes the special exhibition on Hermann Müller-Thurgau, the Swiss scientist behind the famous grape variety. Afterwards, walk the Au peninsula's vineyards and lakeshore; the Au ferry pier is close by.
events.priceText: Museum entry CHF 10 (under-16 free) · tour w/ tasting CHF 30
events.summary: An English-language tour of the lakeside wine museum on the Au peninsula, right after harvest, with vineyards all around.
events.title: Winegrowing on Lake Zurich – English guided tour

events.description: Passenger's shows are intimate and funny, just a guitar and big sing-along choruses. Volkshaus in Kreis 4 is a characterful 1920s hall. A good first 'grown-up' concert for older kids.
events.summary: Mike Rosenberg's warm, storytelling folk ('Let Her Go') in the Volkshaus — gentle enough to bring the kids.
events.title: Passenger

events.description: Rush's reunited 'Fifty Something' tour plays Basel's St. Jakobshalle, the band's only Swiss date. Live Nation lists an 18:00 start. About an hour by train from Zurich; worth making a night of it.
events.summary: Rush are back! Geddy Lee and Alex Lifeson's reunion tour stops in Basel — a must for 70s/80s rock fans.
events.title: Rush — Fifty Something Tour

events.description: FC Zürich host FC Luzern on the weekend of 24–25 October; the exact day and kick-off are set by the Swiss Football League. Sector B tickets from CHF 25, and kids under 6 go free.
events.summary: A late-October Super League weekend at the Letzigrund: FCZ against Lucerne.
events.title: FC Zürich vs FC Luzern

events.description: The Münster band that defined 90s German crossover play Schüür, a cult mid-size club by Lucerne's station. A fun nostalgia trip plus an excuse for a day in Lucerne.
events.summary: 90s crossover-rock heroes H-Blockx ('Move', 'Risin' High') in Lucerne's beloved club Schüür.
events.title: H-Blockx at Schüür Luzern

events.description: The Basel English Panto Group's 2026 show is Beauty and the Beast, directed by Laura Francke, at Scala Basel on 10–13 December. Classic audience participation, songs and a dame – ideal for English-speaking families. About an hour from Zurich by train; tickets usually go quickly.
events.summary: A proper British panto in English – boo the villain, cheer the Beast, shout 'He's behind you!'
events.title: Basel English Panto: Beauty and the Beast

events.description: James McMurtry plays songs from 'The Black Dog & the Wandering Boy', his 11th album, co-produced by early-R.E.M. producer Don Dixon. The Washington Post says he fits 'entire novels' into four-minute songs.
events.summary: Texas's great storytelling songwriter, the one Jason Isbell calls an influence, in a riverside bar.
events.title: James McMurtry

events.description: Chanukah 2026 runs from sunset on 4 December to 12 December. Chabad has put up a public menorah at Paradeplatz in the heart of the city in previous years. Exact 2026 lighting times are not yet published, so check with Chabad Zurich or the ICZ community programme closer to the date.
events.summary: The Chanukah menorah on Zurich's Paradeplatz, lit through the eight nights of the festival.
events.title: Chanukah public menorah lighting, Paradeplatz

events.description: The American International Club of Zurich visits the famous baroque monastery at Einsiedeln for a wine tour and tasting. It's a good way into Zurich's English-speaking community; AICZ also runs monthly TGIF drinks (next: 23 October on the Limmatblick terrace).
events.summary: An English-speaking expat evening at Einsiedeln Abbey, tasting wines made by the Benedictine monks.
events.title: AICZ Monastery Wine Tour, Einsiedeln

events.description: The Scottish 'bagrock' band turn rock and pop anthems into rousing pipe-and-drum arrangements. It's a fun, high-energy Sunday at Kammgarn Schaffhausen.
events.summary: Bagpipes play 'Thunderstruck', 'Don't Stop Believin'' and Queen: the famous bagrock show.
events.title: Red Hot Chilli Pipers

events.description: Delila Paz and Edgey Pires play bluesy, protest-folk-infused rock. Rage Against the Machine's Brad Wilk has played drums with them.
events.summary: New York's firebrand rock'n'soul duo, with Delila Paz's huge voice in a tiny room.
events.title: The Last Internationale

events.description: Allie Sherlock became famous busking on Dublin's Grafton Street and now tours her own songs alongside the covers that made her viral. Salzhaus is a characterful mid-size club in an old salt warehouse near Winterthur station. A lovely gig to bring an older child to.
events.summary: Irish street-busker-turned-YouTube-star Allie Sherlock brings heartfelt folk-pop covers and originals to Winterthur.
events.title: Allie Sherlock at Salzhaus Winterthur

events.description: Anastacia's big-voiced pop-soul show comes to The Hall (formerly Samsung Hall) in Dübendorf, just outside the city. Promoter Gadget lists it as 'Last Call', so remaining tickets are scarce. Easy by S-Bahn to Stettbach or car from Küsnacht.
events.summary: The 'I'm Outta Love' powerhouse belts out her 2000s pop-soul hits in Dübendorf's The Hall.
events.title: Anastacia

events.description: The traditional candle-dipping tent is on Hechtplatz this year, open daily from 14 November to 21 December (Sun–Thu 10:00–20:00, Fri–Sat to 21:00). Kids dip their own candles in coloured wax; you pay by weight. Proceeds support people with disabilities. Weekday afternoons are least crowded.
events.summary: Dip your own beeswax candles layer by layer – Zurich's beloved pre-Christmas craft since 1969.
events.title: Zürcher Kerzenziehen – Candle Dipping

events.description: Over 100 stalls fill the main hall of Zurich HB with gifts, raclette, crêpes and Glühwein around a 10-metre Lindt chocolate tree. Being indoors it's a reliable bad-weather option with kids, and it's right by the S-Bahn home to Küsnacht. Open daily until Christmas Eve.
events.summary: One of Europe's biggest indoor Christmas markets, with a 10 m Lindt chocolate tree – perfect for rainy days.
events.title: Christkindlimarkt at Zurich Main Station

events.description: Westlife's polished arena show runs through two decades of ballads and number ones. Hallenstadion in Oerlikon. Pairs well with Bryan Adams the following night if you want a 90s weekend.
events.summary: Irish 90s boy-band royalty Westlife — 'Flying Without Wings', 'Swear It Again' — big nostalgic arena night.
events.title: Westlife

events.description: Joe Jackson's Hope and Fury tour premieres new material alongside 80s classics. Show 20:00. AllBlues lists 'Last tickets', so act fast.
events.summary: New-wave legend Joe Jackson ('Steppin' Out', 'Is She Really Going Out With Him?') — last tickets in intimate Kaufleuten.
events.title: Joe Jackson & Band

events.description: The hard-rock pioneers return to Hallenstadion with a set spanning 'Highway Star' to 'Smoke on the Water', a song written about the 1971 Montreux casino fire. Show 20:00. A classic-rock bucket-list gig that works for teens too.
events.summary: Rock royalty Deep Purple play 'Smoke on the Water' live — the song famously born on Lake Geneva.
events.title: Deep Purple

events.description: On 13 Jan 2027 the Silvesterchlausen repeat in Urnäsch, Waldstatt, Hundwil, Schönengrund and Schwellbrunn, following the old Julian calendar. Often less crowded than 31 Dec. Weekday (Wednesday), from early morning until night.
events.summary: The Julian-calendar New Year's Eve: Urnäsch's bell-laden Chläuse come out a second time.
events.title: Alter Silvester – Silvesterchlausen (Old New Year)

events.description: Zurich Opera's new Doctor Atomic, sung in English, follows J. Robert Oppenheimer's team in the hours before the Trinity test. Visual artist Vanessa Beecroft directs. A strong pick for English-speaking opera-goers.
events.summary: Date night: John Adams's opera about Oppenheimer and the first atomic test, staged by artist Vanessa Beecroft.
events.title: Doctor Atomic – premiere (dir. Vanessa Beecroft)

events.description: Porter's warm, gospel-tinged jazz ('Liquid Spirit', 'Hey Laura') crosses over easily to non-jazz fans. Show 20:00 at The Hall, presented by AllBlues.
events.summary: Grammy-winning velvet baritone Gregory Porter's soulful jazz — a classy date night in Dübendorf.
events.title: Gregory Porter

events.description: Running since 1471, Basel's autumn fair opens at noon on 24 October to the bells of Martinskirche and fills Barfüsserplatz, Messeplatz, Münsterplatz, Kaserne, Petersplatz and Rosentalanlage plus an indoor hall. Kids love the Münsterplatz Ferris wheel, the Kaserne rides and the Petersplatz 'Hääfelimäärt' stalls; try Chäsbängel and Magenbrot. Main fair to 8 Nov; Petersplatz market to 10 Nov.
events.summary: Switzerland's oldest and biggest fun fair: seven squares of rides, a 60 m Ferris wheel and Mässmogge sweets.
events.title: Basler Herbstmesse

events.description: A newly announced show from Good News brings the Southern-rock institution to The Hall. A classic-rock bucket-list gig at the start of summer.
events.summary: 'Sweet Home Alabama' and 'Free Bird' — Southern-rock legends Lynyrd Skynyrd in Dübendorf.
events.title: Lynyrd Skynyrd

events.description: GC host Lausanne-Sport on the weekend of 7–8 November; the Swiss Football League confirms the exact day and kick-off. A relaxed fixture that suits a first match for the kids.
events.summary: Early-November Super League football with GC at home in the Letzigrund.
events.title: Grasshoppers vs FC Lausanne-Sport

events.description: Every 11 November (St Martin's Day) Sursee's Rathausplatz hosts the Gansabhauet, plus kids' games like sack races and pole climbing. In 2026 it falls on a Wednesday; date inferred from the fixed tradition, times to confirm. The dead goose element may not suit very sensitive children.
events.summary: Blindfolded, sun-masked contestants try to strike down a goose with a blunt sabre – Switzerland's strangest custom.
events.title: Gansabhauet Sursee

events.description: Grasshopper Club Zürich host Young Boys, one of the season's bigger fixtures, at their shared home, the Letzigrund. Sunday matches are easy to fit in with family plans. The kick-off time is confirmed by the Swiss Football League.
events.summary: Sunday football: Zurich's record champions GC take on the Bern giants YB at the Letzigrund.
events.title: Grasshoppers vs BSC Young Boys

events.description: Kodaline's emotive anthems are made for a crowd sing-along, with Bertie Newman in support. X-TRA Haus der Musik is at Limmatplatz, easy by tram.
events.summary: Irish indie-folk heart-swellers Kodaline ('All I Want', 'High Hopes') in X-TRA's mid-size hall.
events.title: Kodaline

events.description: Richard 'Elritschi' Blatter's ensemble plays Mediterranean and Balkan-tinged world folk. They rarely play and 'know no braking' when they do. El Lokal is a quirky riverside bar on the Sihl, next to Gessnerallee.
events.summary: A rare gig from Inner Switzerland's world-folk party band, founded in 1986.
events.title: Jolly & the Flytrap

events.description: On Thursday 1 Oct 2026 from 9:15, Urnäsch farmers bring their herds into the village for the traditional autumn cattle show. Cows are judged and the best receive decorated wreaths; the evening continues in inns with singing and dancing. A weekday event, so best for a day off school.
events.summary: Appenzell farmers parade and judge their best cows, crowned with wreaths – living folklore up close.
events.title: Viehschau Urnäsch (Cattle Show)

events.description: Every 1 March schoolchildren in Engadin villages such as Bever, Samedan and Celerina parade with bells and whips, singing Romansh songs to drive out winter (the story behind the 'Schellenursli' picture book). 2027 falls on a Monday; Bever has already listed its 2027 edition. Combine with a ski weekend.
events.summary: Engadin kids in blue smocks ring enormous cowbells door to door to chase winter away – the Schellenursli custom.
events.title: Chalandamarz, Engadin
events.venue: Village of Bever (and other Engadin villages)

events.description: At 18:00 on Thursday 19 November the 'Lucy' lights along one kilometre of Bahnhofstrasse are switched on, the same day most Zurich Christmas markets open, with late-night shopping until about 21:00. Free and spectacular for kids; wrap up warm.
events.summary: 11,550 light crystals flicker on over Bahnhofstrasse – the magical kick-off to Christmas in Zurich.
events.title: Lucy Christmas Lights Switch-On, Bahnhofstrasse

events.description: A single-work evening built around Mahler's Symphony No. 6, one of the orchestral repertoire's big experiences. Performances are 11–13 November at 7:30pm at the restored Tonhalle on the lakefront.
events.summary: Date night: Paavo Järvi and the Tonhalle-Orchester take on Mahler's monumental Sixth, hammer blows included.
events.title: Tonhalle: Järvi conducts Mahler 6 'Tragic'

events.description: The Landesmuseum's annual Family Day turns the whole museum into a playground of workshops, role-play and discovery stations. Entry and activities are free; popular activities need a free ticket from the Welcome Desk (morning slots from 10:00, afternoon slots from 12:00). Also try the permanent kids' exhibition 'A Magic Carpet Ride Through History'.
events.summary: A free day of costumes, knights, experiments and hands-on workshops across the Landesmuseum castle.
events.title: Family Day at the Swiss National Museum

events.description: Switzerland open their autumn Nations League home run against Slovenia at Lucerne's Swissporarena, about 45 minutes by train from Zurich. It's a late kick-off (20:45), so best for older kids or as a parents' outing. Tickets through the Swiss Football Association's Ticketmaster page.
events.summary: The Nati at home in Lucerne as it pushes for promotion from League B, with the stadium lit up under the floodlights.
events.title: Switzerland vs Slovenia – Nations League

events.description: Bastian Baker plays just voice and guitar in the Rössli's small hall. He also plays Kammgarn Schaffhausen the next night.
events.summary: Swiss singer-songwriter (Shania Twain's tour guest) plays solo and acoustic, up close in Stäfa.
events.title: Bastian Baker – Solo Acoustic Tour

events.description: Quartierverein Oerlikon's lantern parade has two routes: a big one from MFO Park with a drum group (18:30) and a short one for little ones from the Baumacker school meadow with songs first (18:40). Both meet around 19:30 at the Liguster sports field, where children get free baked goods and hot punch; bring a sausage to grill. Weather updates posted 24h before.
events.summary: Hundreds of glowing carved-turnip lanterns wind from MFO Park to a campfire with free punch and pastries for kids.
events.title: Räbeliechtli-Umzug Oerlikon

events.description: Kingfishr are the multi-platinum Irish folk-rock sensation. The Klubsaal show is sold out; Kaufleuten runs a raffle for the last passes, and resale tickets are not honoured.
events.summary: Ireland's chart-topping folk band, their only Swiss show, sold out.
events.title: Kingfishr

events.description: Part of the AllBlues Neumünster series: doors 19:30, concert 20:00, unreserved seats within your price zone. The Seefeld church is ten minutes from Küsnacht.
events.summary: Stacey Kent's feather-light jazz vocals in a candlelit church just before Christmas — pure romance.
events.title: Stacey Kent in Kirche Neumünster

events.description: Fatoumata Diawara has collaborated with Damon Albarn and Herbie Hancock. It's in Rote Fabrik's Aktionshalle, a lakeside former factory in Wollishofen.
events.summary: Mali's Grammy-nominated singer-guitarist, a joyful Wassoulou-meets-funk night by the lake.
events.title: Fatoumata Diawara

events.description: Part of AllBlues' acclaimed Neumünster church series, famed for its acoustics. Doors 19:30, concert 20:00, free choice of seats in your price zone, so arrive early for the front nave. Only 10 minutes from Küsnacht.
events.summary: Lebanese oud master Rabih Abou-Khalil's jazz-meets-Middle-East magic in a candlelit Seefeld church near home.
events.title: Rabih Abou-Khalil in Kirche Neumünster

events.description: An orchestral concert of John Williams and Hans Zimmer's best-known film music. No language barrier and great for kids who know the movies. The Hall, Dübendorf.
events.summary: Star Wars, Harry Potter, Lion King, Gladiator — blockbuster film scores live for the whole family.
events.title: The Music of Zimmer & Williams

events.description: Joey Tempest and Europe play a club-sized show at Volkshaus with The Damn Truth in support. Good News lists the Zurich date as sold out; the Lausanne show at Salle Métropole on 12 October may still have tickets. Watch resale platforms if you're keen.
events.summary: Swedish 80s rock legends Europe in the intimate Volkshaus — 'The Final Countdown' up close. Already sold out.
events.title: Europe (The Final Countdown)

events.description: ZSC host EHC Biel at 19:45 on 23 December. With school out, this makes a good family evening; family packages start at CHF 45 and under-6s go free.
events.summary: The Lions' last home game before Christmas, a fun start to the school holidays.
events.title: ZSC Lions vs EHC Biel – pre-Christmas game

events.description: The Zürcher Derby is the season's highlight at the Letzigrund, with FCZ as the home side on the weekend of 12–13 December (the exact day and time are set by the Swiss Football League). Top-match prices apply (CHF 60–75 in the main stands). Choose seats away from the fan curves with kids.
events.summary: The city derby: FCZ against GC with both fan curves at full volume and huge choreographies.
events.title: Zurich Derby: FC Zürich vs Grasshoppers

events.description: Switzerland's national film festival returns in late January 2027 (62nd edition). Official dates not yet published; a 27 Jan 2027 group visit is advertised, and the festival traditionally runs about a week around that. Most films have English or French/German subtitles.
events.summary: The showcase of Swiss cinema in a baroque town – premieres, directors and a very civilised film week.
events.title: 62nd Solothurner Filmtage

events.description: Bryan Adams consistently delivers one of the most hit-packed arena shows around, big on 80s and 90s anthems. Friendly for teens too. Hallenstadion, Oerlikon.
events.summary: 'Summer of '69', 'Run to You', 'Everything I Do' — Bryan Adams' greatest-hits machine at Hallenstadion.
events.title: Bryan Adams

events.description: On 26 Sept 2026, from about 9:00, herds from the Schwarzsee pastures descend into Plaffeien's village centre with bells and flower headdresses. Market stalls and Sense-district food line the route. Quieter and more local than Charmey on the same day.
events.summary: Up to 1,000 animals stream into Plaffeien from the Schwarzsee alps – a bilingual Fribourg classic.
events.title: Alpabzug Plaffeien / Schwarzsee

events.description: 80s hitmakers Level 42 play Kaufleuten's Klubsaal at 20:00, a rare chance to see them this close. AllBlues marks it 'Last tickets'; the Bern Bierhübeli show on 14 Nov is a backup.
events.summary: Mark King's slap-bass funk-pop — 'Lessons in Love', 'Something About You' — in a club-sized room. Last tickets.
events.title: Level 42

events.description: Switzerland finish their Nations League B campaign at home to Scotland at the kybunpark in St. Gallen (20:45). Expect a great atmosphere from the visiting fans. St. Gallen is about an hour by train from Zurich.
events.summary: The Nati's last home match of 2026: Scotland and their famous travelling Tartan Army come to St. Gallen.
events.title: Switzerland vs Scotland – Nations League

events.description: Muriel Zemp's witty solo jazz show mixes the folk songs and chansons of German- and French-speaking Switzerland. It runs as two sets in the Zehntensaal of the Vogtei Herrliberg. Book by phone (044 915 91 43) from 7 Oct.
events.summary: Swiss folk songs and chansons reinvented with voice, piano, accordion and loop station, one village up the lake.
events.title: Muriel Zemp – Kauderwelsch

events.description: The Escalade festival runs 11–13 Dec 2026 in Geneva's old town, with the historical cortège of the Compagnie de 1602 in period costume, vegetable soup, and kids smashing chocolate cauldrons. The same weekend the Course de l'Escalade fun-run has family categories. A weekend trip by train.
events.summary: Geneva's 1602 victory relived with costumed parades, torchlit cortège and smashing chocolate marmites.
events.title: Fête de l'Escalade, Geneva
